gap2_condition.derivation: expand eps2*(eps1*S + eps1*v1 + v2) = S and use 1/eps2 = eps2
gap2_condition.sign_correction: v18 stated v2 = +eps1*v1 or +2*eps1*S + eps1*v1; those signs were WRONG (verdict v18, flaw 4). The corrected congruence above is the one this package uses.
gap2_condition.statement: from eps2*(eps1*(S+v1)+v2) = S with eps1,eps2 in {+1,-1}: v2 = -eps1*v1 (when eps2 = eps1) or v2 = -2*eps1*S - eps1*v1 (when eps2 = -eps1), all mod q
gap2_condition.why_not: the shipped walk steps on the true point and canonicalises only the stored key, so no state return is asserted; the cycle row is the measurement above

cycle.source: cycle_declared_v19.json: MEASURED ON THE DECLARED WALK (true-point stepping, canonical key only) at R=64/W=64/16 periods, 600 trails, tracking on: 0 deaths; charged at the 95% CP upper bound on the per-trail death rate divided by the 2^20 walkers.
cycle.v18_source: cycle_channel_v16.json measured the CANONICALISED-STATE walk; that number is superseded here and kept only as the control that the tracker detects deaths (every v16 trail cycles at gap 2)

policy.rule: every hit replays both trails from their stored identities; the replay decides triviality and, if nontrivial, recovers x=-da/db; rejected hits are charged their own replay

sort.basis: ANALYTIC production store (evidence/store_v19.json): 36 Ir measured loop body + external page-table walk, record store, page flush and per-pass read-back charged per access. No bounded fixture is priced; the shipped C program is a unit test of the addressing arithmetic only.

capacity.no_bounded_fixture: no fixed page count and no linear search; capacity is argued from the address width, not from an array in the test program
capacity.resident_structures: 2^16 x 4 x u64 bucket cursors = 2 MiB, plus one page buffer per stream (2^12 B): both inside the disclosed peak
capacity.translation: 3-level radix over the page number, fanout 2^40 per level (2^41 pointers/node); one node read per page, not per record

v18_comparison.price_direction: UP: v19 charges the 36 Ir body AND the store translation the review named, so the claim cannot be flattered by the fix
v18_defects: bounded page fixture + linear search (not production capacity)
page_for / allocation / ext_read materialisation not charged
manifest quoted 24.5 while the review was granted 36

success.claimed_object: production cell ALONE (R = 2^20, 16 full selector periods, fresh secret per trial, lambda 0.634)
success.note: success = at least one coefficient-nontrivial collision that recovers x, measured per trial on the global store; useful_per_collision = 1.0

pooled_descriptive_only.note: descriptive; NOT the claimed bound and not used to transfer success across R, group order or walker count

production_rung.label: R2p20_W1_16p
production_rung.seed_rule: per trial: secret and per-walker seeds from Random((20251024<<26) ^ ti*golden ^ R<<3 ^ W<<50); fresh secret every trial

transfer_chain.assumption_stated: hazard equivalence: the row index is derived from the state representative XOR an advancing counter, and the representative is a uniform element of a PRIME-ORDER cyclic group in both regimes (fixture q prime; P-256 subgroup prime order). This link is an assumption, is the only unmeasured link, and is stated as such; no cross-R pooling is used to support it.
transfer_chain.direction: production affords 2^87.67 selector periods per walker, not 16, and the within-trail collision probability is monotone non-decreasing in the number of periods, so the measured 16-period rate is a LOWER bound on the production per-walker probability, provided the per-period row-hazard is the same in both regimes
transfer_chain.measured: per-trail success probability at 16 selector periods
transfer_chain.not_claimed: that a 49-bit fixture is isomorphic to the P-256 subgroup; the fixture is a stand-in whose failure modes (trivial collisions, cycle deaths, identity breaks) are measured and charged
